Strings.proxy_server.intro: Manage sing-box on this server. Start with VLESS + REALITY + Vision. Firewall ports and public DNS must be configured separately.
Strings.proxy_server.publish_hint: Save drafts first, then validate and publish. Publishing restarts a running service and interrupts connections. No traffic accounting or device-count limits are provided.
Strings.proxy_server.name: Name
Strings.proxy_server.expires: Expires at (ISO 8601, UTC; empty means no expiry)
Strings.proxy_server.credential_hint: After saving, publish to enforce changes. Disabling or rotating a draft does not revoke an existing connection. Expiry checks run every 30 seconds while Server is available.
Strings.proxy_server.export_hint: Select a credential from an applied, running service. Exports contain connection secrets. Scan the URI with v2rayNG/v2rayN, or import the matching configuration format.
Strings.proxy_server.apply_warning: Publish the saved draft? Running connections will be interrupted. Confirm that credentials, ports and network access are correct.
Strings.proxy_server.close_warning: Close this window and discard unsaved fields? An operation already submitted to the server will continue.
Strings.proxy_server.saved: Operation completed; refresh status before connecting.
Strings.proxy_server.session_changed: Login or server changed. Reopen the application.
